description: Domain-neutral M-by-N nested control: M parallel authority scopes, each holding an arbitrary order-N CapabilityProgram chain. Local defaults keep cycling while typed integer residual channels escalate upward; scoped top-down leases may constrain the effective outcome without stopping local feedback. Reactive error and proactive control demand share multidimensional envelopes. Context-, failure-, and consolidation-bearing practice compiles task-level outcome basins downward.

microtheory.name: capability_collapse
microtheory.description: There is no privileged System 2 or organism-wide singleton. Each learned conflict domain recursively deepens only beyond its capability envelope; causal interference can discover larger joint domains, and verified corrections settle back into lower local defaults.

rules.name: cc_continuous_arm_requested_cycle
rules.comment: A scheduler epoch re-arms a local authority without waiting for any parent controller.

rules.name: cc_reset_published_outcome
rules.comment: A re-armed collapse retracts its previous publication before opening.

rules.name: cc_reset_active_program
rules.comment: A re-armed collapse restarts from its situated root, never a global home.

rules.name: cc_reset_effective_outcome
rules.comment: Each local cycle recomputes its effective outcome from current defaults and leases.

rules.name: cc_open
rules.comment: Open one collapse at its scoped order-0 program.

rules.name: cc_publish_local_default_while_open
rules.comment: The subsystem keeps cycling its fast default while unresolved cognition proceeds elsewhere.

rules.name: cc_settle_compiled
rules.comment: Muscle memory publishes the exact practiced outcome at the lower order.

rules.name: cc_settle_native
rules.comment: A held capability boundary settles one native opaque outcome.

rules.name: cc_refuse_missing_or_ambiguous_outcome
rules.comment: A boundary can settle only one held outcome; absence or multiplicity remains explicit.

rules.name: cc_residual_deepen
rules.comment: Only surprise outside the held boundary opens the next same-typed program.

rules.name: cc_request_synthesis_no_higher_program
rules.comment: No held higher-order program covers the surprise; request synthesis without fabricating an outcome.

rules.name: cc_stop_at_configured_order_limit
rules.comment: Configured deployment depth is a resource choice, not an architectural order ceiling.

rules.name: cc_request_synthesis_ambiguous_higher_program
rules.comment: A branch is itself an unresolved cognition problem; the core does not pick an arbitrary continuation.

rules.name: cc_channel_settle_compiled
rules.comment: All trusted residual channels are inside their envelopes; publish the practiced basin.

rules.name: cc_channel_settle_native
rules.comment: A multidimensional capability envelope settles without collapsing its channels to one score.

rules.name: cc_channel_refuse_missing_or_ambiguous_outcome
rules.comment: A contained envelope still requires one coherent outcome for its conflict domain.

rules.name: cc_channel_residual_deepen
rules.comment: Any trusted reactive or proactive channel outside its envelope opens the next same-typed program.

rules.name: cc_record_traversed_residual_channels
rules.comment: Keep every breached dimension as evidence; never collapse the envelope to a scalar score.

rules.name: cc_channel_request_synthesis_no_higher_program
rules.comment: An exhausted local envelope continues its default and exposes unresolved channels upward.

rules.name: cc_channel_stop_at_configured_order_limit
rules.comment: A deployment cap stops local deepening without stopping the subsystem default.

rules.name: cc_effective_from_settlement_empty
rules.comment: A completed local correction supersedes its provisional default unless a parent lease is active.

rules.name: cc_effective_from_settlement_replace_default
rules.comment: A completed local correction supersedes its provisional default unless a parent lease is active.

rules.name: cc_expire_scoped_override_lease
rules.comment: Authority returns locally when its explicit integer lease expires.

rules.name: cc_apply_scoped_override_empty
rules.comment: One valid parent lease changes only this authority scope; the local feedback loop keeps running.

rules.name: cc_apply_scoped_override_replace
rules.comment: One valid parent lease changes only this authority scope; the local feedback loop keeps running.

rules.name: cc_refuse_overlapping_override_leases
rules.comment: Two authorities cannot silently command the same conflict domain.

rules.name: cc_publish_unresolved_channels_to_parent_scope
rules.comment: An exhausted subsystem sends only unresolved typed residuals upward, not its entire sensorium.

rules.name: cc_discover_coupled_authority_scopes
rules.comment: Observed causal interference, not anatomy names, discovers which effectors require joint settlement.

rules.name: cc_provision_channel_practice_trace
rules.comment: Each residual dimension earns evidence independently at its observed integer band.

rules.name: cc_credit_channel_practice_success
rules.comment: Channel evidence is serialized so simultaneous subsystem receipts cannot overwrite one another.

rules.name: cc_credit_channel_practice_failure
rules.comment: Channel evidence is serialized so simultaneous subsystem receipts cannot overwrite one another.

rules.name: cc_compile_channel_capability_boundary
rules.comment: Evidence expands only its own capability dimension and installs the practiced outcome basin.

rules.name: cc_decompile_failed_channel_capability
rules.comment: A failed dimension retracts its learned boundary and reopens the higher-order route.

rules.name: cc_credit_compiled_execution_failure
rules.comment: Failure of an automatic execution is direct evidence against the compiled basin, even without deepening.

rules.name: cc_revoke_failed_compiled_outcome
rules.comment: Devaluation or repeated execution failure restores the pre-practice envelope and higher-order access.

rules.name: cc_reset_failed_compiled_channel_boundary
rules.comment: Every learned dimension of a failed basin returns to its graph-held baseline.

rules.name: cc_provision_verified_practice_trace
rules.comment: Verified success or failure becomes context- and residual-band-specific evidence.

rules.name: cc_credit_verified_practice
rules.comment: Practice credits a reproduced task-level outcome basin at one evidenced residual band.

rules.name: cc_credit_verified_practice_failure
rules.comment: A failed reproduction is evidence against capability, never a successful receipt.

rules.name: cc_consolidate_practice_trace
rules.comment: Optional offline consolidation is explicit graph evidence, not assumed from immediate performance.

rules.name: cc_compile_muscle_memory
rules.comment: Repeated, context-diverse, failure-bounded evidence compiles a task-level outcome basin downward.

rules.name: cc_decompile_failed_muscle_memory
rules.comment: Failure or devaluation reopens cognition instead of preserving an unsafe automatic boundary.

rules.name: cc_complete_continuous_cycle
rules.comment: Completion advances only the local authority epoch; independent scopes continue at their own rates.
